The '''Nacht-5 smoke grenade''', also known as a '''smoker''', was a [[Smoke grenade/Legends|smoke grenade]] produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. They were primarily used as a means of obscuring vision and as a low-tech signaling device. Different [[Color/Legends|colors]] of smoke were available as well, such as [[Color/Legends|red]] or blue.<ref name="ROE" />
